items.title: Jack DeJohnette — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewer mentions Ken Kimery as the sound engineer and says 'I can speak for Ken in this regard as well', but the interviewee (Jack DeJohnette) does not mention Ken Kimery or indicate any personal interaction or relationship with him.

ctx.x: Interviewer: Dr. Anthony Brown with sound engineer Ken Kimery Description: Transcript, pp. 107

Today is November 10th, 2011, and this is The Smithsonian Oral History Interview with NEA Jazz Master, percussionist, pianist, bandleader, composer, arranger, educator, and my hero, Jack DeJohnette, in his house in Silver Hollow, Upstate New York. How are you doing today, Mr. DeJohnette?
